## DE analysis; protein-coding using all protein_cdoing genes as size factors; 
## sncRNA (w/o tRNAs) using all sncRNAs as size factors
## This section is stored in "IBC.image"
```{r, echo=FALSE}
dat<-read.delim("all_IBC_cleanedup.counts")
dat<-dat[c(1:33,35:65,67:89)]
colnames(dat)[34:38]<-paste0("PBMC_H1",1:5)
colnames(dat)[65:69]<-paste0("Plasma_H1",1:5)
dat$Type<-as.factor(dat$Type)
dat$Type2<-as.factor(dat$Type2)
coldata <- data.frame(c(rep("Healthy",4),rep("F_nonIBC",4),rep("nonIBC",4),rep("IBC",10),
                        rep(c(rep("Healthy",15),rep("nonIBC",6),rep("IBC",10)),2)),
                      c(rep("H",4),rep("NA",4),
                        rep(c("N","P"),2),
                        c("P","N","N",rep("P",6),"N"),
                        rep(c(rep("H",15),
                        c("N","P","P","N","N","P"),
                        c("P","N","N",rep("P",6),"N")),2)),
                      c(rep("Forzen Tissue",8),rep("FFPE",14),rep("PBMC",31),rep("Plasma",31)),
                      colnames(dat)[2:85],
                      row.names=colnames(dat)[2:85])
colnames(coldata) <- c("Disease","HR","Tissue","Name")
coldata$Disease<-factor(coldata$Disease,levels=c("Healthy","F_nonIBC","nonIBC","IBC"))
coldata$HR<-factor(coldata$HR,levels=c("H","NA","N","P"))
#mRNA DE
pro_dat<-dat[dat$Type=="Protein coding",]
FFPE_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,2:23],
                                   colData = coldata[1:22,],design = ~Disease)
PBMC_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,24:54],
                                   colData = coldata[23:53,],design = ~Disease)
Plasma_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,55:85],
                                     colData = coldata[54:84,],design = ~Disease)
FFPE_dds <- DESeq(FFPE_dds,parallel = T)
PBMC_dds <- DESeq(PBMC_dds,parallel = T)
Plasma_dds <- DESeq(Plasma_dds,parallel = T)
# creat deseq objects for HR analysis using the same size factors, 
FFPE_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,10:23],
                                   colData = coldata[9:22,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
PBMC_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,39:54],
                                   colData = coldata[38:53,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
Plasma_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pro_dat[,70:85],
                                   colData = coldata[69:84,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
sizeFactors(FFPE_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_dds)[9:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_dds)[16:31]
sizeFactors(Plasma_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_dds)[16:31]
FFPE_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_HR,parallel = T)
#sncRNA DE
snc_dat<-dat[dat$Type=="sncRNA"|dat$Type=="miRNA",]
snc_dat$Type2<-droplevels(snc_dat$Type2)
FFPE_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,2:23], 
                                       colData = coldata[1:22,],design = ~Disease)
PBMC_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,24:54], 
                                       colData = coldata[23:53,],design = ~Disease)
Plasma_snc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,55:85], 
                                         colData = coldata[54:84,],design = ~Disease)
FFPE_snc_dds <- DESeq(FFPE_snc_dds,parallel = T)
PBMC_snc_dds <- DESeq(PBMC_snc_dds,parallel = T)
Plasma_snc_dds <- DESeq(Plasma_snc_dds,parallel = T)

FFPE_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,10:23],
                                     colData = coldata[9:22,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
PBMC_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,39:54],
                                     colData = coldata[38:53,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
Plasma_snc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = snc_dat[,70:85],
                                       colData = coldata[69:84,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
sizeFactors(FFPE_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_snc_dds)[9:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_snc_dds)[16:31]
sizeFactors(Plasma_snc_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_snc_dds)[16:31]
FFPE_snc_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_snc_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_snc_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_snc_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_snc_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_snc_HR,parallel = T)

#lncRNA DE
lnc_dat<-dat[dat$Type=="Antisense"|dat$Type=="lincRNA"|dat$Type=="Other lncRNA"|dat$Type=="Pseudogene",]
lnc_dat$Type<-droplevels(lnc_dat$Type)
FFPE_lnc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = lnc_dat[,2:23], 
                                       colData = coldata[1:22,],design = ~Disease)
PBMC_lnc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = lnc_dat[,24:54], 
                                       colData = coldata[23:53,],design = ~Disease)
Plasma_lnc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = lnc_dat[,55:85], 
                                         colData = coldata[54:84,],design = ~Disease)
sizeFactors(FFPE_lnc_dds) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_dds)
sizeFactors(PBMC_lnc_dds) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_dds)
sizeFactors(Plasma_lnc_dds) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_dds)

FFPE_lnc_dds <- DESeq(FFPE_lnc_dds,parallel = T)
PBMC_lnc_dds <- DESeq(PBMC_lnc_dds,parallel = T)
Plasma_lnc_dds <- DESeq(Plasma_lnc_dds,parallel = T)

FFPE_lnc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = lnc_dat[,10:23],
                                     colData = coldata[9:22,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
PBMC_lnc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = lnc_dat[,39:54],
                                     colData = coldata[38:53,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
Plasma_lnc_HR <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = lnc_dat[,70:85],
                                       colData = coldata[69:84,],design = ~Disease+HR+Disease:HR)
sizeFactors(FFPE_lnc_HR) <- sizeFactors(FFPE_lnc_dds)[9:22]
sizeFactors(PBMC_lnc_HR) <- sizeFactors(PBMC_lnc_dds)[16:31]
sizeFactors(Plasma_lnc_HR) <- sizeFactors(Plasma_lnc_dds)[16:31]
FFPE_lnc_HR <- DESeq(FFPE_lnc_HR,parallel = T)
PBMC_lnc_HR <- DESeq(PBMC_lnc_HR,parallel = T)
Plasma_lnc_HR <- DESeq(Plasma_lnc_HR,parallel = T)

#function for volcano plot
plot_volcano<-function(dat_non_sig,dat_sig,x_lim,y_lim,xlab_seq,
                       ylab_seq,title,type,leg_posx,leg_posy){
  plot(dat_non_sig$log2FoldChange, -log10(dat_non_sig$padj),xlim=x_lim,ylim=y_lim,
       main=title, xlab=bquote(log[2](FC)),xaxt="n",bty="n", yaxt="n",
       ylab=bquote("-"*log[10]*"(adjusted p-value)"),col=mcol[1],
       pch=20, cex=0.7)
  axis(side = 1,at = xlab_seq,labels = xlab_seq)
  axis(side = 2,labels = ylab_seq,at = ylab_seq,las=1)
  abline(v=0, col="black", lty=3, lwd=1.0)
  abline(v=-2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=2.0)
  abline(v=2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=2.0)
  abline(h=-log10(0.001), col="black", lty=3, lwd=2.0)
  if (type=="pro"){
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=20, col=mcol[2], cex=0.7)
    legend(leg_posx,leg_posy,pch=20,bty="n",col=c(mcol,"white"),
           legend =c("Non-significant",as.expression(bquote("|"*log[2]*"(FC)|">=2)),
                     as.expression(bquote(padj<=0.001))),cex=0.7)
  } else if (type=="snc") {
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=21, 
           bg=scol[dat_sig$Type2], cex=0.7,lwd=0.5)
    legend(leg_posx,leg_posy,pch=21,bty="n",pt.bg=c(mcol[1],scol),cex=0.7,pt.lwd = 0.5,
           legend =c("Non-significant",levels(dat_sig$Type2)))
  }
}
mcol<-c("black","red")
scol<-brewer.pal(9, "Set1")
pcol<-brewer.pal(4,"Paired")
#simplified volcano for TIFF output
plot_volcanoS<-function(dat_non_sig,dat_sig,x_lim,y_lim,xlab_seq,ylab_seq,type){
  plot(dat_non_sig$log2FoldChange, -log10(dat_non_sig$padj),xlim=x_lim,ylim=y_lim,
       main=NA, xlab=NA,xaxt="n",bty="n", yaxt="n",
       ylab=NA,col=mcol[1],
       pch=20, cex=0.2)
  axis(side = 1,at = xlab_seq,labels = NA,tck=-0.02,lwd=0.5)
  axis(side = 2,labels = NA,at = ylab_seq,las=1,tck=-0.02,lwd=0.5)
  abline(v=0, col="black", lty=3, lwd=0.5)
  abline(v=-2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=0.5)
  abline(v=2, col="black", lty=4, lwd=0.5)
  abline(h=-log10(0.001), col="black", lty=3, lwd=0.5)
  if (type=="pro"){
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=20, col=mcol[2], cex=0.2)
  } else if (type=="snc") {
    points(dat_sig$log2FoldChange,-log10(dat_sig$padj), pch=21, 
           bg=scol[dat_sig$Type2], cex=0.2,lwd=0.2)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# generate results for pair-wise comparison
# Between diseases/tissues/HR
# function of generating results
# Combine all result data.frames to a list
res_convert<-function(comp_arg, pro_odj, snc_obj,lnc_obj){
  res<-data.frame(results(pro_odj,contrast = comp_arg, alpha = 0.05))
  res<-cbind(res,pro_dat[,c(1,87)])
  res_snc<-data.frame(results(snc_obj,contrast = comp_arg, alpha = 0.05))
  res_snc<-cbind(res_snc,snc_dat[,c(1,87)])
  res_lnc<-data.frame(results(lnc_obj,contrast = comp_arg, alpha = 0.05))
  res_lnc<-cbind(res_lnc,lnc_dat[,c(1,87)])
  res<-rbind(res,res_snc,res_lnc)
  res<-res[complete.cases(res),]
  res$log10padj<-log10(1/res$padj)
  return(res)
}
#  01-06, FFPE_dds and FFPE_snc_dds
# 01. Frozen tissue; nonIBC vs Healthy (4:4)
comp <- c("Disease","F_nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res<-list(res_01=res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds,FFPE_lnc_dds))

# 02 FFPE; IBC vs nonIBC (10:4)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","nonIBC")
comp_res$res_02<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds,FFPE_lnc_dds)

# 03 FFPE IBC vs Frozen Healthy (10:4)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_03<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds,FFPE_lnc_dds)

# 04 FFPE IBC vs Frozen nonIBC (10:4)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","F_nonIBC")
comp_res$res_04<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds,FFPE_lnc_dds)

# 05 FFPE nonIBC vs Frozen Healthy (4:4)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_05<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds,FFPE_lnc_dds)

# 06 FFPE nonIBC vs Frozen nonIBC (4:4)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","F_nonIBC")
comp_res$res_06<-res_convert(comp, FFPE_dds, FFPE_snc_dds,FFPE_lnc_dds)

# 07-09, PBMC_dds and PBMC_snc_dds
# 07 PBMC IBC vs Healthy (10:15)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_07<-res_convert(comp, PBMC_dds, PBMC_snc_dds,PBMC_lnc_dds)

# 08 PBMC IBC vs nonIBC (10:6)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","nonIBC")
comp_res$res_08<-res_convert(comp, PBMC_dds, PBMC_snc_dds,PBMC_lnc_dds)

# 09 PBMC nonIBC vs Healthy (6:15)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_09<-res_convert(comp, PBMC_dds, PBMC_snc_dds,PBMC_lnc_dds)

# 10-12, Plasma_dds and Plasma_snc_dds
# 10 Plasma IBC vs Healthy (10:15)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_10<-res_convert(comp, Plasma_dds, Plasma_snc_dds,Plasma_lnc_dds)

# 11 Plasma IBC vs nonIBC (10:6)
comp <- c("Disease","IBC","nonIBC")
comp_res$res_11<-res_convert(comp, Plasma_dds, Plasma_snc_dds,Plasma_lnc_dds)

# 12 Plasma nonIBC vs Healthy (6:15)
comp <- c("Disease","nonIBC","Healthy")
comp_res$res_12<-res_convert(comp, Plasma_dds, Plasma_snc_dds,Plasma_lnc_dds)

# HR results HR+ vs HR-
# HR_01, FFPE nonIBC
# as shown by resultsNames, the main effect is HR+ vs HR- in nonIBC
comp <- c("HR","P","N")
comp_res$HR_01 <- res_convert(comp, FFPE_HR, FFPE_snc_HR,FFPE_lnc_HR)
# HR_02, FFPE IBC
# use the list of contrast to get IBC HR+ vs HR-
comp <- list(c("HR_P_vs_N","DiseaseIBC.HRP"))
comp_res$HR_02 <- res_convert(comp, FFPE_HR, FFPE_snc_HR,FFPE_lnc_HR)

# HR_03, PBMC nonIBC
comp <- c("HR","P","N")
comp_res$HR_03 <- res_convert(comp, PBMC_HR, PBMC_snc_HR,PBMC_lnc_HR)
# HR_04, PBMC IBC
comp <- list(c("HR_P_vs_N","DiseaseIBC.HRP"))
comp_res$HR_04 <- res_convert(comp, PBMC_HR, PBMC_snc_HR,PBMC_lnc_HR)

# HR_05, Plasma nonIBC
comp <- c("HR","P","N")
comp_res$HR_05 <- res_convert(comp, Plasma_HR, Plasma_snc_HR,Plasma_lnc_HR)
# HR_06, Plasma IBC
comp <- list(c("HR_P_vs_N","DiseaseIBC.HRP"))
comp_res$HR_06 <- res_convert(comp, Plasma_HR, Plasma_snc_HR,Plasma_lnc_HR)

# combined normalized counts for heatmap
comp_vst<-list(FFPE=rbind(counts(FFPE_dds, normalized=TRUE),counts(FFPE_snc_dds, normalized=TRUE),
                          counts(FFPE_lnc_dds, normalized=TRUE)))
comp_vst$PBMC<-rbind(counts(PBMC_dds, normalized=TRUE),counts(PBMC_snc_dds, normalized=TRUE),
                          counts(PBMC_lnc_dds, normalized=TRUE))
comp_vst$Plasma<-rbind(counts(Plasma_dds, normalized=TRUE),counts(Plasma_snc_dds, normalized=TRUE),
                          counts(Plasma_lnc_dds, normalized=TRUE))
comp_vst$FFPE_HR<-rbind(counts(FFPE_HR, normalized=TRUE),
                        counts(FFPE_snc_HR, normalized=TRUE),
                        counts(FFPE_lnc_HR, normalized=TRUE))
comp_vst$PBMC_HR<-rbind(counts(PBMC_HR, normalized=TRUE),
                        counts(PBMC_snc_HR, normalized=TRUE),
                        counts(PBMC_lnc_HR, normalized=TRUE))
comp_vst$Plasma_HR<-rbind(counts(Plasma_HR, normalized=TRUE),
                        counts(Plasma_snc_HR, normalized=TRUE),
                        counts(Plasma_lnc_HR, normalized=TRUE))

save.image("IBC.image")
```

## CDS, sense_antisense plots
```{r,echo=FALSE}
#Protein coding reads, #of sense and antisense
#Protein coding reads, #of sense and antisense

scol <- brewer.pal(4, "Set1")
sense_anti<-read.delim("protein_sense_anti.txt")
rownames(sense_anti)<-c("Sense","Antisense")
CDS<-read.delim("CDS.txt")
rownames(CDS)<-c("CDS","UTR","Intron","Intergenic")

sense_anti<-prop.table(as.matrix(sense_anti),2)
CDS<-prop.table(as.matrix(CDS),2)

pdf("IBC_protein_reads.pdf",width=11,height=8)
par(mfrow=c(2,1))
mp<-barplot(as.matrix(sense_anti[,c(1:84)]*100),col=scol,axes=F,
            names.arg=rep(NA,84),
            width=0.15,
            space=0.5,
            legend.text=c("Sense strand","Antisense strand"),
            adj=0,args.legend=list(x=19,xjust=0,y=50,yjust=0.5,bty="n",cex=0.7),xlim=c(0,21))
mtext("Protein coding reads",line=1.4,at=median(mp[1:84]),cex=1.5)
axis(1,labels=NA,at=mp,lwd=0,lwd.ticks=1)
axis(2,labels=c(0,25,50,75,100),las=1,at=c(0,25,50,75,100),pos=0,cex.axis=0.7)

mp<-barplot(as.matrix(CDS[,c(1:84)]*100),col=scol,axes=F,
            names.arg=rep(NA,84),
            width=0.15,
            space=0.5,
            legend.text=rownames(CDS),
            adj=0,args.legend=list(x=19,xjust=0,y=50,yjust=0.5,bty="n",cex=0.7),xlim=c(0,21))
axis(1,labels=NA,at=mp,lwd=0,lwd.ticks=1)
axis(2,labels=c(0,25,50,75,100),las=1,at=c(0,25,50,75,100),pos=0,cex.axis=0.7)
dev.off()
```
